digest.component_or_area: peer confirmations store and evidence reconciliation
propositions: On fresh upgrade (store file absent), all managed refs with bound targets must be backfilled as confirmed with source=backfill and direction=backfill to prevent the first post-upgrade pass from declining every legitimate peer deletion
Backfill must skip managed refs with unbound targets and must not re-run if the store file already exists, even if empty

The evidence step must use a single store instance opened once, with backfill running first, then snapshot confirmation on the same instance, to ensure backfilled records are visible to snapshot confirmation and prevent lost-update race conditions

Backfill must check for existing push or snapshot records before writing and skip if a record already exists, so provenance never downgrades, but later snapshot confirmation can overwrite backfilled entries
Backfilled records must be treated as confirmed by is_confirmed() without distinguishing backfill from proof at the decision point
